definitions.unique_visitors: Distinct people who used the product in the period (signed-in account or browser, AI agents excluded). Someone who comes on three days counts once. Same figure as /app-usage.
definitions.uses: Page loads in which the visitor clicked, typed or filled in the app, added up over the period.
definitions.daily: Distinct people per day. The days add up to more than the period's unique visitors when people return.

agents.note: Fee-paying volume of your account's agents (clones included), shared by the whole company.

rules: Active user: 2 active days = 10 points, +1 for each further day from the 3rd, up to 20 per user per product.
Trading agents: 1 point per 100 USDC of fee-paying volume, no cap.
Every product counts separately; your own and test accounts earn nothing.
Returning visitor (signed out, same browser on 2+ days): 1 point, +0.25 per further day from the 3rd; at most 25 % of your signed-in points.
